entities.summary: Eugenia Volodymyrivna Chuprina is a contemporary Ukrainian poet, writer, and playwright. She is the Chair of the Organizing Committee of the International Prize, Olesya Ulyanenko; member of the Ukrainian PEN; member of the National Union of Writers of Ukraine; and the National Union of Journalists She is the winner of the Vladimir Korolenko Prize. Chuprina is the author of poem collections, Твори (Works) and Вид знизу (2002); prose Роман з Пельменем and mashup novel, Орхидеи ещё не зацвели (2010).
